blocks.name: board
blocks.notes: The board model shared by the UI and the server (src/board.ts).

blocks.name: serialize
blocks.notes: The board → architecture file renderer (src/serialize.ts); grammar in docs/adr/0001.

blocks.name: generate
blocks.notes: Runs the agent and judges its work (src/generate.ts).

blocks.name: server
blocks.notes: The local API, as a Vite dev-server plugin (vite.config.ts). Every /api call must come from the app's own origin.

blocks.name: Target
members: repo: string (relative to the board file)

blocks.name: BLOCK_KINDS
blocks.value: entry, library, service, constant, type, interface, class, field, function, module

blocks.name: EDGE_KINDS
blocks.value: inherits, implements, imports, uses, calls, returns, emits, handles, other

blocks.name: newBlock
blocks.intent: Creates a block of the kind with a fresh id and sensible empty fields.

blocks.name: canContain
blocks.intent: Says whether a container kind may hold a child kind: modules hold anything, classes hold const/type/field/fn, interfaces hold fn.

blocks.name: duplicate
blocks.intent: Copies the chosen blocks with everything inside them under fresh ids, plus edges between copied blocks; top-level copies are nudged.

blocks.name: serialize
blocks.intent: Renders the board as the deterministic architecture file and lists lossy-mapping warnings for the language.

blocks.name: signatureText
blocks.intent: Normalises a loose signature so its parameter list is always parenthesised.

blocks.name: edgeVerb
blocks.intent: Names an edge by its kind, or by its label for a labelled other edge.

blocks.name: blockLine
blocks.intent: Renders one block's line without indent or @id.

blocks.name: loadBoard
blocks.intent: Reads and validates a board file, failing with a readable error.

blocks.name: saveBoard
blocks.intent: Validates and writes the board file and its derived .arch.md next to it, creating the folder.

blocks.name: validate
blocks.intent: Checks everything the serializer and UI rely on: version, kinds and their fields, containment, cycles, edges, target.

blocks.name: generate
blocks.signature: ({ arch, lang, outDir, runner, verify?, onProgress?, signal? }) -> GenerateResult
blocks.intent: Runs the agent in a fresh out/<lang>/<timestamp> folder, re-checks its claim with the language's checks, ties errors to blocks and prunes old runs.

blocks.name: update
blocks.signature: ({ arch, repo, checks, runner, verify?, boardFiles?, onProgress?, signal? }) -> GenerateResult
blocks.intent: Updates an existing clean repository in place on a new scaffold/<timestamp> branch, verifies with its own checks and reports the changed files.

blocks.name: runChecks
blocks.intent: Runs the language's check commands, returning their output as errors when one fails.

blocks.name: isRunDir
blocks.intent: True only for folders generate() made.

blocks.name: claudeRunner
blocks.intent: Runs claude -p with the prompt on stdin, auto-accepting edits in the working folder and only the allowed tools, streaming progress and stopping on abort.

blocks.name: buildPrompt
blocks.intent: Writes the instructions for generating a fresh project in the language.

blocks.name: buildUpdatePrompt
blocks.intent: Writes the instructions for updating an existing project to match its architecture file.

blocks.name: board
blocks.detail: GET/POST /api/board?path=… loads or saves a board file

blocks.name: generate
blocks.detail: POST /api/generate?path=… saves the board, then streams progress and one done result as SSE; one run at a time

blocks.name: cancel
blocks.detail: POST /api/generate/cancel with { runId } aborts the current run only when runId names it
blocks.notes: Cancel must only abort the run it names, so a Cancel from one tab can never stop another tab's run. /api/generate sends a first `start` SSE event carrying a fresh run id; the UI keeps it and its Cancel posts { runId }; a cancel whose runId is not the current run's answers 409 and aborts nothing. Add a unit test for the id check.

blocks.name: open
blocks.detail: POST /api/open opens a finished run folder in the file manager

blocks.name: App
blocks.intent: The editor: palette, canvas with nesting and edges, inspector, live architecture file, generate/run panel, undo/redo and shortcuts.

blocks.name: Inspector
blocks.intent: Edits a block's kind-specific fields and notes.

blocks.name: BoardInspector
blocks.intent: Edits where Generate sends the board: a new project, or an existing repository with its check commands.

blocks.name: RunPanel
blocks.intent: Shows a run's status, branch, folder, errors linked to their blocks, files and live progress.
